title:
Epic to update dataValidationUi.ApplicationState based on pageParams
when the data validation page is loaded in.
Loads in the page settings. If a completed run is found, the page data will be loaded in as well.
The action payload should contain the following:
   loaderId: The id of the spinner component to set as loading while the epic runs.
   panelId: The id of the tab panel to set the primary button as loading.
   stateId: The id of the application state to update.
   bannerId: The id of the banner to show for run updates if an in progress run is found.
UpdateDataValidationAppStateEpic is used to manage the UI components related to data validation, ensuring that:
1. The user sees loading indicators during processing.
2. The page settings and any in-progress or completed run data are reflected in the UI.
name: UpdateDataValidationAppStateEpic
